text:
Each Sanskrit word is split at its sandhi and compound junctures into its constituent words in unjoined Devanagari, separated by '+'. Answer with the split only.

puruṣaśca => puruṣaḥ + ca
padaviṣiṣṭatvābhāvāditi cenn => cet + na
punastatrauttāya => punaḥ + tatra + utthāya
yāvadhasya => yāvat + asya
dhanamapi => dhanam + api
